title: Mild Jerk Chicken with Rice and Peas
summary: Allspice-thyme baked chicken with coconut rice and kidney beans; heat is optional.

ingredients.name: ground allspice
ingredients.note: half for the chicken, half for the rice

ingredients.name: scotch bonnet
ingredients.note: deseeded; for the grown-up portion only

steps.text: Blend {list:spring-onions,ginger,garlic,thyme,lime,soy,sugar,oil} with half the {allspice} into a paste.
Rub the paste over the {chicken} and leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan) and bake the chicken until cooked through and tender.
Meanwhile, put {list:rice,coconut} in a pan with the rest of the allspice and 200ml water, and bring to the boil.
Cover, turn the heat down and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the {beans}, cover and leave off the heat until the liquid is absorbed.
Rub a little {chili} over the grown-up chicken only.
Slice the chicken into strips and serve with the rice and peas.

toddlerTips: Scotch bonnet is very hot: keep it out of the toddler's portion entirely.
Cut chicken into thin strips or shred it; squash a few beans for younger toddlers.
No added salt: the paste gets its flavour from allspice, thyme and lime.

sources.title: Jerk chicken with rice & peas (BBC Good Food)
